preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three lines.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and n <= 60000 and m >= 4 and m <= 100000 and k >= 1 and k <= 1000
preconditions.description: The integers n, m, and k satisfy the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: len(f) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in f)
preconditions.description: The list f contains exactly n integers, each representing a valid field index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == m and all(0 <= x < 998244353 for x in p) and sum(p) % 998244353 == 1
preconditions.description: The list p contains exactly m integers representing probabilities modulo M, and their sum modulo M equals 1.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 998244353 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains an integer between 0 and M-1 inclusive.
The sum of all output probabilities modulo M equals 1, representing a valid probability distribution.

For each field i (1-indexed), the i-th output line represents the probability that the chip ends at field i after k turns, calculated by: initializing uniform probability 1/n for all fields, then for each turn, updating the probability distribution by summing over all possible die rolls d (weighted by p[d]) and all possible jump sequences of length d starting from each field, all arithmetic performed modulo 998244353.
